title: bug: stale comments/docs left after CQ-F (approvedPlanRevision, launcher stamping, submit_plan requiredChecks)
description:
Comment/doc drift found in CQ-F12's epic sweep (no behavior change needed):
1) packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:802-803 says an absent approvedPlanRevision includes "an omitted-token human approval", but CQ-F04b deleted that path (token-free human approvals are refused INVALID_INPUT).
2) scripts/moe-agent.sh:1352,6273 and moe-agent.ps1:1157,5711 say moe-proxy stamps identity only onto get_context/start_step; since CQ-F12a it also stamps complete_step/complete_task (a wrapper edit hot-reloads the fleet, so land it deliberately).
3) docs/MCP_SERVER.md submit_plan executionContract listing (~line 311) omits the ninth field requiredChecks (CQ-V01a; EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FIELDS in state/validators.ts).
definitionOfDone: The three stale statements match the code at HEAD
F12b drift test (src/util/executionContractDocs.test.ts) and parity-check.sh stay green

Keep existing F12b tests unchanged; missing file/section error handling must throw, never skip or match unrelated nearby prose. Guard exact behaviors, not entire prose paragraphs.

implementationPlan.note:
Self-review, round 2. The only delta from HEAD is the docs hunk, so no code was reviewed again; QA confirmed statements 1 and 2 at HEAD. I traced statement 3 to state/validators.ts:
- EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FIELDS = Object.keys(CONTRACT_FIELD_KINDS), including requiredChecks: 'checks'.
- MAX_REQUIRED_CHECKS = 20.
- id (1-64 chars, unique) and command are required.
- configs/scripts/assertionRoots are optional, each at most MAX_REQUIRED_CHECK_PATHS = 50.
- checkRefs stays a string list.
The doc hunk states exactly this. The drift tests fail on pure HEAD (3 cases) and pass with the hunk (17/17), so a regression of statement 3 is caught. No fixes and no new defects.
Landing risk checked: get_commit_scope lists docs/MCP_SERVER.md as asserted with no peer contest, and declare_files was recorded.
